verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS terminal and SSH/Mosh client with a built-in local command set, so shipping local git tooling such as commit amend or reset is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the documented local commands (cat, grep, ls, cp, etc.) and the transfer tools (scp, sftp, curl) never include git. Nothing in the evidence shows amending or undoing commits within Blink itself, beyond running git on a remote host over SSH.
